findings.description: This bucket is explicitly noted as public with no ACL restricting access, and lacks server-side encryption, versioning, and access logging, exposing stored data (customer master file) to unauthorized access and tampering.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects in this bucket are stored unencrypted at rest.
A sensitive customer master spreadsheet is uploaded to a publicly accessible, unencrypted bucket, exposing confidential customer data.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving financial data unencrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving operational data unencrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving data science data unencrypted at rest.
